output.reason: The brief backs its claim with specific evidence (5.9% stalls on smart-TV 5.2 against 0.6–0.7% for every other client, plus the same fault in dogfood on Corvane), and it gives a cheap, reversible fix that is easy to test. One thing is still unexplained: the release digest says 5.2 went live in all markets, which conflicts with the brief's claim that Kestria was a canary market.
